verdict.rationale: RevenueCat documents scheduled data exports that send app data to cloud storage or email on a user-controlled schedule. Per-customer subscription and purchase data can also be pulled through CustomerInfo and the secret-key REST API. Nothing in the evidence addresses porting stored payment methods out to another provider, and the export docs do not confirm full coverage of invoices or usage records. missing for 10: payment-method portability to another provider, explicit invoice and usage-record export coverage, documented export schema or completeness guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration of an exit migration.
